node.title: XR rank-five collision directions form a star configuration
node.statement: For a retained rank-five u=v=0 agreement block A, the cubic interpolation hyperplanes p(x)=q(x), x in A, are in simple position: Vandermonde independence gives unique fourfold intersections I_Tq and the divided-difference bridge excludes fivefold intersections. Their C(4+h,4) vertices are the projective collision directions. A nonzero degree-d polynomial on cubic-coefficient space is nonzero on at least C(4+h-d,4) vertices for d<=h, sharply. Therefore the official r=2 reused direction sets lie on no nonzero hypersurface of degree at most 4/4/2. This is local direction rigidity, not a point count.
